content:
tara: noticed a short-lived spike in token usage on Console for a canary. ledger shows no commit for the trace. thought it might be transient but it lingered ~90s. anyone seen this pattern?

omar: trace id? streaming or sync?

tara: trace=tr_44c7. streaming chat. client disconnected, retried, router sent to a different region. there's also a /tools/lookup toolcall in the session.

li: likely provisional meters from the first attempt never got reconciled after the fallback. console aggregates provisionals by default and it makes the heatmap look bad.

zane: do we currently tag provisional meter events with route or any attempt id?

omar: no, meter currently emits {estimate, user, trace}. no route or provisional_key. logs: 
```
[router] tr=tr_44c7 route=us-west-2 -> eu-north-1 (fallback)
[meter] provisional_add u=u-92 +48 tokens (streaming-est)
[ledger] no commit for tr_44c7
```

ops-bot: created ticket PLAT-5620 "provisional spike w/ region fallback"

tara: UX question: should Console hide provisional spikes until settled? it's noisy for oncall.

li: ops needs realtime signal though. compromise: show provisional as a faint cross-hatched overlay and include "provisional" tooltip + trace link.

zane: infra fix: attach `provisional_key` + `route` to meter events. router should produce a deterministic provisional_key (hash of session_id||req_digest||toolcall_fp) so quick retries map. ledger will emit `provisional_settle` when commit happens so Console can correct the view.

omar: edge: clients without session_id. router can synthesize from connection fingerprint but may collide. still better than nothing. add a `provisional_source_tags` array so Console can filter out tool-only provisional noise.

li: also add reconcile worker that auto-closes provisionals older than 5m (reason=orphan_autoclose) and emits `provisional.reconciled` metric. Console fades those buckets.

tara: sounds good. can we also emit a `provisional_mismatch` metric when we see multiple provisional_keys for same trace? helps postmortem.

zane: will add that. implementation plan:
- router: deterministic provisional_key (PR#2101)
- meter: accept provisional_key, route, source_tags (PR#2102)
- ledger: persist provisional index + emit provisional_settle events (PR#2103)
- console: provisional overlay + reconcile consumer (PR#2104)

omar: tests: streaming + mid-request retry + region fallback + truncated toolcall payload. integration test should assert Console cell corrected after settle/reconcile.

ops-bot: linked PLAT-5620 -> PR #2101, PR #2102, PR #2103, PR #2104

tara: I'll own the Console changes. li take meter, zane ledger, omar router?

li: yep. I'll add unit tests for toolcall-tagging and a small e2e.

zane: adding the settle hook and a backfill job to index recent provisional logs for debugging.

omar: will make provisional key derivation deterministic and document the header `X-Provisional-Key`.

tara: thanks. keeping thread open for PR links and a screenshot when UX is ready. :white_check_mark:
